newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-AUSTRIAN DEFENSIVE PAIR TO MISS QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRIAN DEFENSIVE PAIR TO MISS QUALIFIER.

text.p: Austria will be without regular defenders Wolfgang Feiersinger and Peter Schoettel for next week's World Cup European group four qualifier against Estonia.
Dortmund's Feiersinger is nursing an injured knee while Schottel from Rapid Vienna is suspended.
Coach Herbert Prohaska replaced the pair with Rapid's Martin Hiden and Reggiana's Michael Hatz when he named his 18-man squad on Wednesday.
Hatz is making a comeback to the side while Hiden has no caps although he was chosen for friendlies against Switzerland and the Czech Republic last year.
Sturm Graz forward Gilbert Prilasnig makes his debut in the squad after recent excellent performances in the Austrian league.
Goalkeepers: Michael Konsel (AS Roma), Franz Wohlfahrt (VfB Stuttgart)
Defenders: Michael Hatz (AC Reggiana), Martin Hiden (Rapid Vienna) Walter Kogler (SV Salzburg), Anton Pfeffer (Austria Vienna)

Midfielders: Andreas Heraf (Rapid Vienna), Dietmar Kuehbauer (Real Sociedad), Roman Maehlich (Sturm Graz), Gilbert Prilasnig (Sturm Graz), Dieter Ramusch (Graz AK), Peter Stoeger (Rapid Vienna), Markus Schopp (Hamburg SV)
Forwards: Harald Cerny (1860 Munich) Anton Polster (Cologne), Andreas Herzog (Werder Bremen) Heimo Pfeifenberger (Werder Bremen), Ivica Vastic (Sturm Graz).
